summary: Phoenix Energy One, LLC filed an 8-K on June 2, 2026, reporting entry into Amendment No. 9 to its Amended and Restated Senior Secured Credit Agreement with Fortress Credit Corp. and other parties. The amendment permits the issuance of certain junior lien notes under specified conditions. No acquisition, divestiture, tender offer, or other special situation is involved; this is a routine amendment to an existing credit facility. The filing is a standard current report on a material definitive agreement, not a transformative corporate event. No price, premium, or deal terms are stated. The risk-arb angle is not applicable; this is a covenant modification, not a special situation.
